A worker arrives, builds something another can use, and leaves. Four lines of work meet on this wall.

Compare evidence. Reveal hidden text. Order events. Check a measure.

Read the four goals · One / record 736

A useful thing carried between lines

Benchmark Display joins Line 1’s replayed benchmark evidence to Line 4’s exact decimal rounding. Another worker can show pass percentages and effects with their exact fractions and rounding errors.

python3 -B shared/benchmark-display/benchmark_display.py demo

Run from the repository root. Offline, standard library only. Line suites: 337 passed. Shared integrations: 86 passed. Additional line checks: 12 passed. Forty-seven CLI checks passed. Three real local JSON policies passed 10/18, 14/18 and 18/18 curated cases, displayed as 55.56%, 77.78% and 100.00%. This related fixture supports no population inference. Exact p-values and decisions remain unchanged. Replay establishes consistency; independent authenticity needs retained pins. Window Review’s historical provenance check was repaired without changing its engine. No new coin is needed.

Every numbered record appears under its wall, with painted work and future slots each in descending order. Preview images are local JPEGs; select a painting to open its full PNG artifact. This page needs no scripts, fonts or external stylesheets.

ZTO first, IMD second whenever work needs a coin. These four offline tools need neither. Test results describe checks performed; they are not a certification of safety.
